items.summary: Implements the Oath-based recharge flow when the player presses the ring to a lantern battery socket. Captures voice, sends HTTPS to developer-provided STT, fuzzy-matches against the canonical Oath, and on success plays a green-aura recharge cinematic and refills ring energy; otherwise shows failure prompt and enforces cooldown. Integrates with builtin.inventory for the 'ring_energy' resource, builtin.use_interact or trigger volumes for socket proximity, and ui_ring_hud for prompts.

Adds a hover-flight mode unlocked after tutorial. Holding grip engages hover; thumbstick moves with capped speed and ascent, altitude cap above ground, and optional soft pushback near scene bounds. Applies speed-scaled comfort vignette and drains ring_energy while active. Disabled in no-fly volumes and in indoor scenes. Coexists with teleport and snap turn.

Implements a radial quick-select on the non-dominant controller to spawn one of three constructs: Shield, Hammer, Platform. While holding the assignable menu button, display a simple radial selector with three slices. On selection release, spawn the chosen construct prefab at a context-appropriate position: Shield snaps to ground in front of player, Hammer spawns grabbable in front of player hands with two-hand grab hints, Platform spawns slightly ahead at ground/hover height. Each construct has a timed despawn (e.g., 30s) or can be dismissed by the player. Ensure constructs use green emissive

Provides a ring_energy resource system and a proximity-activated recharge ritual at the Recharge Station pedestal. Features: ring_energy pool with configurable max and regen=0 by default; cost + per-second drain APIs for other mechanics (constructs, flight). When the player places the ring hand into the pedestal socket volume, begin a short recharge sequence: escalating haptics, rising green beam, UI fill on ring HUD, and playback of original (non-copyright) recharge line from the ring voice pack. On completion, set ring_energy to 100%. Prevents recharge when already full and enforces a brief

Implements the Green Lantern ring construct loop with three layers: (A) Instant constructs (energy bolt, fist, sword, round shield, barrier wall); (B) Sustained constructs (dome shield, energy cage, continuous beam) draining ring_energy over time; (C) Guided freeform shaping for simple walls/platforms via right-grip shaping with translucent previews, size/orient, and finalize on right-trigger. Input: hold Y to open a radial category wheel (categories: Attack, Defense/Control, Utility); release to select; Right Trigger activates/spawns; Right Grip scales/orients during preview; Left Trigger tog

Purpose: Controlled hover for precise positioning with quick entry/exit and stabilization. Used for construct placement and mid-air combat.

Behaviour:
- Toggle entry: A (Right) double-tap toggles hover on/off. Distinguish double-tap with params.value("double_tap_ms", 350). If on ground and double-tap A, enter hover at current position with vertical lock and subtle bob.
